understanding.purpose: 跟踪会议待办事项，明确每项任务、负责人、截止时间和状态。
understanding.reading: 读者主要按行查看任务及其落实情况，再纵向扫描负责人、截止时间和状态以比较各项进度。
groups: 负责人、Due 和状态共同描述任务的执行情况，适合保持紧凑并便于纵向扫描。
# 与 Action item 共同标识任务；Action item 承载主要文字，需要最多空间。
keep_intact: 英文单词及缩写，如 GDPR、Jenkins 和 GitHub Actions
may_wrap: Action item 中的中英文描述可在自然断点换行；较长任务形成的行高可容纳同一行其他单元格的换行。
必要时负责人或状态中的多词内容可在词间换行。

preferred.name: r1B
preferred.note: Give six more pixels to task descriptions, accepting status values wrapping between Chinese characters. Names and dates retain their stated minimum widths.

acceptable.name: r1C
acceptable.note: Give the owner column five more pixels than in balanced-intact, while preserving full dates and status values. This tests whether a little more space around names improves the execution columns without making task descriptions as narrow as r0C.

acceptable.name: r3C
acceptable.note: 完整保留负责人表头、姓名和日期，同时给状态列更多空间；以较窄的任务列换取执行信息更稳定的纵向扫描。

bad.name: r2A
bad.note: 把序号列收至刚好容纳内容，将空间给任务列，同时恢复状态列宽。保留 r1B 较好的任务排布，并让状态值完整显示。
bad.why: Dates split across lines, the owner header stacks one character per line, and the owner 王强 is split.

bad.name: r2B
bad.note: 收窄序号列并扩大负责人列，让三个字的表头完整显示；以较窄的任务列为代价，检验更清晰的表头层级是否值得。
bad.why: Dates split across lines, making the due-date column harder to scan and compare.

bad.name: r2C
bad.note: 进一步扩大任务列，测试长英文描述能否获得更自然的换行；状态列仅比 r1B 宽 1px，用于检验状态换行与任务可读性之间的取舍。
bad.why: Dates and the owner 王强 split across lines, while the owner header stacks one character per line.

bad.name: r3A
bad.note: 把负责人列增至 66px，使表头和姓名保持完整；Due 增至 54px 保持日期完整。状态列收紧，让状态在字间换行，把剩余空间留给任务描述。
bad.why: The status header and every status stack into narrow vertical fragments, weakening a column meant for quick scanning.

bad.name: r3B
bad.note: 保留接近 r2C 的宽任务列，并把 Due 加宽至 57px，优先修复日期拆分；负责人和状态仍可能换行，用于比较任务可读性与执行信息完整性的取舍。
bad.why: The owner header stacks one character per line and the name 王强 splits, disrupting the owner column.

rationale: r1B gives the action descriptions enough room to keep the longest cells to four lines while preserving whole dates and owner names. Its two-line owner header and status values are a reasonable compromise within the phone viewport. r1C keeps statuses on one line, but its narrower action column produces a six-line cell and a less even row rhythm.

general: Protect compact identifiers, names and dates from splitting when readers need to scan or compare them.
Give the most variable text column enough width to preserve readable phrases, while keeping related short fields legible.
Judge wrapping by its effect on the whole row and column, not by table height alone.
specific: At this viewport width, the action descriptions compete directly with Chinese status labels for space.
A 51px owner column stacks the three-character header and splits 王强 in the rendered candidates; 52px avoids those faults.

tradeoffs: r1C trades a taller action row for one-line status values; a designer who prioritizes rapid status scanning could reasonably prefer it. r3C gives owners more room but leaves the long English action at six lines.
uncertain: The ranges are conservative single values: the supplied renders do not establish which nearby widths remain equally good when the other columns are adjusted. Exact wrapping thresholds would need additional browser renders.

critique.good: The action column has enough room for recognizable phrases, while names and status values remain readable. Rows retain a clear relationship between each task and its execution details.
critique.problems: The owner header wraps, and three dates split across lines, making the deadline column harder to scan. The longest task also creates a tall row.
critique.cause: The 51px Due column leaves 30px for text, just short of the 31px needed for the dates. The 65px owner column leaves less room than the header’s full one-line width, while 135px for Action item requires several lines for long descriptions.

critique.good: The wider action column gives the task descriptions a more comfortable rhythm and substantially reduces row heights.
critique.problems: The owner header stacks one character per line, Tom breaks within the name, dates split, and status values wrap. The narrow execution columns disrupt both row reading and vertical comparison.
critique.cause: The 50px owner column leaves only 29px for text, the 51px Due column leaves 30px, and the 55px status column leaves 34px. Those widths are too tight for several of their values.

critique.good: Names and dates stay intact, and the generous deadline column makes dates easy to scan. English words do not split mid-word.
critique.problems: The action descriptions form tall, narrow blocks, with short fragments at the ends of several rows. Status values still wrap, and the owner header wraps.
critique.cause: The 122px action column leaves only 101px for text, while the 67px Due column uses more width than the dates need. The 65px status column leaves 44px, slightly less than the 46px needed for a full status value.

critique.good: 状态值、日期和负责人都保持完整，执行信息纵向扫描清楚；任务文字没有拆开英文单词。
critique.problems: 负责人表头断成两行，第二项任务的英文描述较零碎，第三项也占了较多行。
critique.cause: 负责人列宽 52px，文字区只有 31px，容不下三个汉字；Action item 列宽 150px，限制了长英文短语的排布。

critique.good: 156px 的任务列让第二项缩至四行，英文短语完整，整体行距也较紧凑。
critique.problems: 所有三字状态都被拆行，削弱了逐行辨认和纵向比较；负责人表头仍然断行。
critique.cause: 状态列宽 61px，文字区只有 40px，放不下三个汉字；负责人列仍为 52px。

critique.good: 状态值、日期和负责人保持完整，执行信息读起来整齐。
critique.problems: 第二项任务被分成六行，英文句子显得支离；负责人表头依然断行，因此增加的负责人列宽没有解决主要问题。
critique.cause: 任务列从 150px 缩到 145px，使英文描述多次换行；负责人列虽增至 57px，文字区仍不足以容纳三个汉字。

critique.good: 序号与任务的关系清楚，任务列获得了主要空间；各行有足够的高度容纳中英文描述。
critique.problems: 负责人表头逐字竖排，王强被拆成两行；多数日期被拆开，状态也频繁换行，削弱了执行信息的纵向扫描。
critique.cause: 负责人列 51px 只有 30px 内容宽度，放不下三字表头或姓名的完整宽度；Due 列 51px 比最长日期所需的 52px 少 1px。状态列 65px 也略低于完整显示最长状态所需的 67px。

critique.good: 负责人列较宽，王强保持完整，负责人信息比其他两版更容易辨认。
critique.problems: 负责人表头仍换行；任务描述更窄，第二项达到六行，整行显得过高。日期仍被拆开，状态也频繁换行。
critique.cause: 负责人列 64px 比三字表头所需的约 66px 略窄；任务列缩至 140px，增加了英文描述的换行。Due 列 51px 仍不足以容纳最长日期。

critique.good: 任务列最宽，第二项压缩到四行，整表高度较低；任务文字的节奏比 r2B 舒展。
critique.problems: 负责人表头逐字竖排，王强被拆开；多数日期被拆开，状态值也换行。执行信息与任务主体之间的阅读节奏因此不够稳定。
critique.cause: 负责人列 51px 不足以容纳完整表头和最长姓名；Due 列 51px 比最长日期所需的 52px 少 1px；状态列 60px 放不下最长状态。

review.method: two fresh-context blind reviews; letters shuffled; includes browser auto layout and equal widths as neutral references

r3C.why: Dates and names stay intact, but the narrow status column splits every status, and the long English action takes six lines.

ref_equal.why: The action column is so narrow that English words break across lines, making rows exceptionally tall and hard to scan; the number column wastes space.

ref_auto.why: The action column reads well, but the status header and values stack character by character, weakening a key column for scanning progress.

r2A.why: Dates split across lines, as do a person's name and the status values; the narrow owner header also stacks vertically.

r1C.why: Names, dates and statuses stay intact, supporting quick comparison. The action column wraps heavily, especially the English item, and the owner header splits.

r1B.why: The action column has comfortable line lengths and keeps English words intact, while names and dates remain whole. Status values and the owner header wrap.

raw.unsure: F gives the action text more room and a shorter second row, but E's intact status values make the table easier to scan across rows.

r1C.why: Status labels, names and dates stay intact, and the action items remain readable. The owner header wraps, and the long English action takes several lines.

r1B.why: The action column has useful room, but every status label wraps and the owner header breaks across lines.

ref_equal.why: The action column is far too narrow: English words and identifiers split across lines, making rows difficult to read and compare.

ref_auto.why: Action items read comfortably, but the status header and labels stack almost character by character, weakening the table’s scanability.

r2A.why: Dates split across lines, the Chinese owner name breaks, and both the owner header and status labels wrap heavily.

r3C.why: Names and dates remain intact, but status labels and the owner header wrap, while the action items still occupy several lines.

raw.unsure: The images are small, so some individual line breaks are difficult to inspect; the relative column proportions and wrapping are clear.

provenance.note: AI visual design judgement; not a human reading study
